[P1] 小猪变形记
本·科特(英)文/图
金波 审译
外语教学与研究出版社
聪明豆绘本
小熊
聪明豆绘本

[P2] 这一天，小猪觉得很无聊。“真烦。”他嘟囔着，“烦、烦、烦、烦、烦！总该有点儿什么好玩儿的事吧，我去找找看！”
于是，他小跑着出去了。

跑到路边，小猪看到长颈鹿在吃树梢上的叶子。他瞪大眼睛，一个劲儿地盯着人家瞧，“我敢说，做长颈鹿一定很刺激。”突然，小猪想到了一个绝妙的好主意！

[P3] 小猪咚咚地跑回去做了一对高跷，然后踩着高跷散步去了。
路上，小猪遇到了斑马。“嗨，下面的那位！”小猪跟斑马打招呼，“我是一只了不起的长颈鹿，我可以看到好几里远的地方。”
“你不是长颈鹿！”斑马大笑着说，“你是一只踩着高跷摇摇晃晃的小猪，你最好小心点儿。”
小猪气呼呼地走开了，但是没走多远……

[P4] 砰！
“哦，天哪！”小猪一边掸着灰，一边感叹，“看来长颈鹿的生活不适合我。我要去寻找更刺激的探险！
还没走出两步，小猪又想到了一个好主意！

[P5] 他找来颜料，给自己画了一件奇妙的新外套，然后他一路小跑着炫耀去了。

“嗨！”小猪跟大象打招呼，“我是一只了不起的斑马！你看，我身上有斑马纹。”
“你不是斑马！”大象大笑着说，“你是一只身上画着斑马纹的小猪，你马上就……”

[P6] 哗啦！
小猪漂亮的外套被水冲了个一干二净，
吓得他惊慌地乱叫起来。

“讨厌！”小猪叹了口气，“当斑马还不如当小猪呢！我敢说，
做大象一定更有趣……”
还没等身上的水全干，小猪又想到了一个好主意！

[P7] “嗨！”小猪跟袋鼠打招呼，“我是一只了不起的大象！我能用鼻子喷水。”
“你不是大象！”袋鼠大笑着说，“你是一只鼻子上装了塑料管的小猪。”
小猪正想争辩，突然……
小猪在自己的鼻子上绑了一根长长的塑料管，在两只耳朵上绑了两片大树叶。然后他踩踩脚，又出门去了。

[P8] 阿——嚏——
他打了个大大的喷嚏，把塑料管
喷飞了！

“嗯——”小猪哼哼着，“当大象一点儿都
不好玩儿！不过，当袋鼠一定很有趣。”他马上
又想到了一个好主意。

[P9] 小猪在自己的脚上绑了两个大弹簧，然后他踩着弹簧、一蹦一跳地出门去了。

“嗨！”小猪跟鹦鹉打招呼，“我是一只了不起的袋鼠！我能跳得跟房子一样高。”
“你不是袋鼠！”鹦鹉尖叫着说，“你是一只踩着弹簧的小笨猪，再说你跳得也不高。”
鹦鹉真没礼貌，小猪气坏了，一心想跳给鹦鹉看。他跳得越来越高，越来越高……

[P10] ……他蹦到了一棵树上，被倒挂起来了！
小猪挂在树上，是啊是啊，“唉，要是我会飞该多好啊。”他气喘吁吁地从树上爬了下来。不过，这样一来，小猪又想到了一个绝妙的好主意！

[P11] 他找来羽毛和贝壳，给自己做了一对翅膀和一个大鸟嘴。然后，他拍着翅膀出门去了。

“嗨！”小猪跟猴子打招呼，“我是一只了不起的鹦鹉！你的眼睛能看多远，我就能飞多远。”
“你不是鹦鹉！”猴子大笑着说，
“你是一只披着羽毛的小猪，猪不会飞！”

[P12] 猴子说对了。小猪根本没飞起来，他就像一块大石头，一头栽进了树下的泥潭里！
“真倒霉！”他躺在泥潭中央，吧唧吧唧地拍打着泥巴，“事情都搞砸了，当小猪一点儿乐趣都没有！'

就在这时，旁边传来一个声音——

[P13] “你说什么，当猪怎么没有乐趣了？我就是猪，我在泥潭里面打滚，觉得很好玩儿啊。你快试试吧！”
于是小猪也跟着滚来滚去……

他滚得越多，身上就越脏，身上越脏，他心里就越快乐。
“太棒啦！”小猪高兴得大叫，“原来当小猪是最开心的事情呀！”

[P15] 可以毫不奇怪地说，这是一本哲学书，只是借了图画书的形式，所以变得特别轻松幽默。

画中的动物极具人的特点，各种表现又极为夸张，比如：小猪给自己画斑马纹时，不但刷子是斑马纹的，连颜料本身也是斑马纹的！更为夸张的是，它一路走还一路用尾巴吊着刷子，这种滑稽的小细节随处可见，使整个故事读来荒诞又充满童趣！

——虹泥巴 阿甲

ISBN 7-5600-6137-0

一个字全书教育性
出版机构

网址：http://www.fitrp.com
http://children.fitrp.com

主题建议：少儿读物 / 图画故事

ISBN 7-5600-6137-0
定价：14.90元
full_text_en:
[P1] The Little Pig's Transformation
Ben Cort (UK) Text & Illustrations
Jin Bo, Editor and Translator
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press
Clever Bean Picture Book
Little Bear
Clever Bean Picture Book

[P2] One day, the little pig felt very bored. "Ugh," he grumbled, "bored, bored, bored, bored, bored! There must be something fun to do. I'll go look for it!" 
So he ran off.

On the roadside, the little pig saw a giraffe eating leaves from the treetop. He opened his eyes wide and stared at it intently, "I bet being a giraffe would be really exciting." Suddenly, the little pig had a brilliant idea!

[P3] The little pig trotted back, made a pair of stilts, and then went for a walk on them.
On the way, the pig met a zebra. "Hi, the one down there!" the pig called out to the zebra. "I'm a magnificent giraffe, and I can see for miles and miles!"
"You're not a giraffe!" the zebra laughed. "You're a wobbly little pig on stilts. You'd better be careful!"
The pig stomped off angrily, but didn't get far...

[P4] Bang!
“Oh, my!” Piglet said, brushing off the dust, “It seems the life of a giraffe isn’t for me. I’m going to find something more exciting to explore!
Not even two steps further, Piglet had another great idea!

[P5] He found some paint, painted himself a wonderful new coat, and then ran off proudly.

"Hi!" the pig greeted the elephant. "I'm an amazing zebra! Look, I have zebra stripes!"
"You're not a zebra!" the elephant laughed. "You're a pig with zebra stripes painted on you. You'll be..."

[P6] Splash!
Little Pig's fancy coat was washed clean off, 
scaring him into a panic.

"Ugh!" sighed Pig. "Being a zebra is worse than being a pig! I bet 
being an elephant would be more fun..."
Before his body was even dry, Pig had another brilliant idea!

[P7] "Hi!" the pig greeted the kangaroo, "I'm an amazing elephant! I can spray water with my trunk."
"You're not an elephant!" the kangaroo laughed, "You're a pig with a plastic tube on your nose."
The pig was about to argue, suddenly...
The pig tied a long plastic tube to his nose and two big leaves to his ears. Then he stomped his feet and went out again.

[P8] A——choo——
He sneezed loudly, blowing the plastic tube
away!

“Hmm——” the pig grunted, “Being an elephant is no fun at all! But being a kangaroo must be exciting.” He immediately
thought of a great idea.

[P9] The pig tied two big springs to his feet, then stepped on them and bounced out the door.

"Hi!" the pig greeted the parrot. "I'm an amazing kangaroo! I can jump as high as a house!"
"You're not a kangaroo!" the parrot shrieked. "You're a silly pig on springs, and besides, you're not jumping very high!"
The parrot was so rude! The pig got angry and wanted to show the parrot. He jumped higher and higher, higher and higher...

[P10] ……He bounced onto a tree and got stuck upside down!
While hanging on the tree, the pig thought, "Ah, how wonderful it would be if I could fly." He panted as he climbed down. However, in this way, the pig came up with another brilliant idea!

[P11] He found some feathers and shells, made himself a pair of wings and a big bird beak. Then, he flapped his wings and went out.

"Hi!" the pig greeted the monkey. "I'm a wonderful parrot! Your eyes can see how far, I can fly that far!"
"You're not a parrot!" the monkey laughed loudly,
"You're a little pig wearing feathers. Pigs can't fly!"

[P12] The monkey was right. The little pig didn't fly at all—he fell like a big stone right into the mud pit under the tree!
"What a mess!" he lay in the center of the mud, splashing it with a *plop-plop*, "Everything's ruined. Being a little pig is just no fun at all!"

Just then, a voice came from nearby—

[P13] "What are you talking about? Being a pig is so much fun! I'm a pig, and rolling around in the mud is great fun. You should try it!"
So the little pig started rolling around too...

The more he rolled, the dirtier he got, and the dirtier he got, the happier he felt.
"Wow!" the little pig shouted happily, "Being a pig is the most fun thing ever!"

[P15] It can be said without surprise that this is a philosophical book, only presented in the form of a picture book, thus becoming particularly light-hearted and humorous.

The animals in the illustrations possess distinctly human characteristics, and their behaviors are extremely exaggerated. For example, when the pig paints itself with zebra stripes, not only is the paintbrush striped, but the paint itself is striped too! Even more exaggerated is that it walks along while swinging the brush with its tail. Such comical details are everywhere, making the entire story absurd yet full of childlike fun!

— Hong Ni Ba, A Jia

ISBN 7-5600-6137-0

One-character educational book
Publishing Institution

Website: http://www.fitrp.com
http://children.fitrp.com

Theme suggestion: Children's books / Picture stories

ISBN 7-5600-6137-0
Price: 14.90 RMB
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小猪变形记》的封面，展示了一只长着翅膀的小猪在蓝天下的形象，作者为本·科特，译者为金波，由外语教学与研究出版社出版，属于聪明豆绘本系列。
[P2] 小猪觉得无聊，决定出去找乐子。他看到长颈鹿吃树叶，羡慕不已，突然想到一个绝妙的主意。
[P3] 小猪用高跷模仿长颈鹿，遇到斑马后被识破并嘲笑，生气地离开，但没走多远。
[P4] 小猪模仿长颈鹿失败后摔倒，感叹长颈鹿生活不适合自己，决定寻找更刺激的探险，并很快又想到了新主意。
[P5] 小猪用颜料把自己画成斑马，跑去向大象炫耀，但被大象识破并嘲笑，未能成功伪装。
[P6] 小猪被大象用鼻子喷水冲得狼狈不堪，脱掉了斑马伪装，感叹当斑马不如当小猪，并立刻又想到要模仿大象的新主意。
[P7] 小猪用塑料管和树叶装扮成大象，向袋鼠炫耀，但被识破并嘲笑，正想争辩时突然发生意外。
[P8] 小猪装扮成大象时打了个大喷嚏，把塑料管喷飞了，他觉得当大象不好玩，于是又想到要模仿袋鼠的新主意。
[P9] 小猪用弹簧装扮成袋鼠，向鹦鹉炫耀，但被识破并嘲笑，气得想跳得更高证明自己。
[P10] 小猪蹦到树上被倒挂住，感叹如果会飞就好了，随后又想到了一个新主意。
[P11] 小猪用羽毛和贝壳装扮成鹦鹉，向猴子炫耀自己能飞，但被猴子识破并嘲笑，因为猪不会飞。
[P12] 小猪装扮成鹦鹉试图飞翔失败，一头栽进泥潭，沮丧地抱怨当小猪没乐趣，此时旁边传来一个声音。
[P13] 小猪在泥潭里打滚，越滚越开心，最终意识到当小猪才是最有趣的事情。
[P14] 画面展示了一片开阔的草原，长颈鹿、斑马、大象、袋鼠和一只装扮成鹦鹉的小猪依次排列。小猪躺在泥潭里，身上沾满泥巴，周围散落着羽毛和贝壳，显得狼狈又开心，其他动物则在一旁围观。
[P15] 本页为绘本的封底，包含一段关于本书的推荐语，强调其哲学性与幽默感，以及动物角色的人性化和夸张表现。同时列出了ISBN、出版社信息、网站和定价等出版信息。
